## Black Bean and Corn Salsa

This is a mild salsa, though you can probably add some peppers or chile.

**Source:** I think an aunt told me about it.


**Ingredients:**


```{r}
#| label: black-bean-corn-salsa

dat <- tibble(
  Ingredients = c(
    "1 can black beans",
    "1 can corn",
    "1 red/green pepper",
    "Feta cheese",
    "Cilantro (optional)",
    "1/4 - 1/2 cup Onion (optional)"
  ),
  spcr1 = " ",
  Tools = c(
    "Bowl",
    "Can opener",
    "Spoon",
    "Knife",
    "Cutting board", 
    ""
  )
)


colnames(dat)[str_detect(colnames(dat), "spcr")] <- ""

dat |> 
  tt(  theme = "striped" ) |> 
  style_tt(fontsize = 0.8) |> 
  style_tt( i=0, background=bgcol, color="white") 


```



**Directions:**

- Drain the beans and corn (you may want to rinse the beans), and empty them into a bowl.
- Dice up the peppers. I like to try to get the chunks are approximately the same size as the beans and corn. Add them to the bowl.
- Do the same to the feta cheese, if you want that. Add it to the bowl.
- Mix it all up.

**Variations:**

- Add onion to it. I would start with 1/4 - 1/2 an onion, again diced to about the same size.
- If you want some heat, dicing up some jalapeno peppers or green chile would probably go well.


**Notes:**

- It’s been a while since I’ve made this, so I don’t remember how much cilantro I used. I think about 1/4 cup, loosely filled, and then minced up.
